# Research Intake Inbox — Return of Zero

[Reading entrance](../../../README.md) · [48 movements](../../../section-rooms/README.md)

Paste today's books, links, scans, citations, quotations, and hunches here without having to solve the architecture first. Nothing in this inbox is citation-ready. During processing, each item enters its canonical `<source_id>.md`, becomes an intake-queue question, or moves to an argument/concept note.

## New source lead

Duplicate this block:

```markdown
### INBOX-SOURCE-001 — [rough label]

- **What I have:** link / book / PDF / scan / photo / citation / memory
- **Author or institution:**
- **Possible title:**
- **Edition / date if visible:**
- **Where it came from:**
- **Why it matters:**
- **Likely station/argument:**
- **Local file or URL:**
- **Processing status:** unprocessed
```

## New quote or excerpt

Duplicate this block and preserve the text exactly:

```markdown
### INBOX-QUOTE-001 — [rough source label]

> [paste exact passage]

- **Source as currently known:**
- **Page / section / timecode as currently known:**
- **Was this typed, copied, OCR'd, or heard?:**
- **Surrounding context available?:**
- **Claim it seems to support:**
- **Likely station/argument:**
- **Processing status:** unverified
```

## New research hunch

A hunch is not a source. Record it here so it can be routed without creating another pseudo-reference node.

```markdown
### INBOX-HUNCH-001 — [claim or connection]

- **The connection:**
- **What would count as evidence:**
- **Possible source families:**
- **Likely argument home:**
- **Processing status:** needs-source-design
```
